title: Manufactured Building and Mobile Home Installers
description: Move or install mobile homes or prefabricated buildings.

projection.title: Manufactured building and mobile home installers

tasks.text: Move and set up mobile homes or prefabricated buildings on owners' lots or at mobile home parks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating heavy equipment by hand in field

dwas.name: Move large objects using heavy equipment.
Install prefabricated or manufactured structures.

tasks.text: Seal open sides of modular units to prepare them for shipment, using polyethylene sheets, nails, and hammers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sealing gaps requires hands-on application

dwas.name: Seal gaps or cracks to prevent leakage or moisture intrusion.

tasks.text: Repair leaks in plumbing or gas lines, using caulking compounds and plastic or copper pipe.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Pipe leak repair requires hands-on manipulation

dwas.name: Repair pipes to stop leaking.

tasks.text: Connect water hoses to inlet pipes of plumbing systems, and test operation of plumbing fixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting hoses to piping is manual fitting

dwas.name: Connect hoses to equipment or piping.

tasks.text: List parts needed, estimate costs, and plan work procedures, using parts lists, technical manuals, and diagrams.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Record parts and repair details from provided data

dwas.name: Estimate costs for labor or materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Plan work procedures.
Record information about parts, materials or repair procedures.

tasks.text: Install, repair, and replace units, fixtures, appliances, and other items and systems in mobile and modular homes, prefabricated buildings, or travel trailers, using hand tools or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Appliance installation requires physical labor

dwas.name: Install home appliances.

tasks.text: Inspect, examine, and test the operation of parts or systems to evaluate operating condition and to determine if repairs are needed.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — System checks partly aided by telemetry, still human-verified

dwas.name: Inspect systems to determine if they are operating properly.
Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Confer with customers or read work orders to determine the nature and extent of damage to units.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis from description aided, repair judgment human

dwas.name: Read work orders or descriptions of problems to determine repairs or modifications needed.
Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Remove damaged exterior panels, repair and replace structural frame members, and seal leaks, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Structural repair is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Remove parts or components from equipment.
Seal gaps or cracks to prevent leakage or moisture intrusion.
Repair structural components.

tasks.text: Open and close doors, windows, and drawers to test their operation, trimming edges to fit, using jackplanes or drawknives.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Cut materials according to specifications or needs.

tasks.text: Locate and repair frayed wiring, broken connections, or incorrect wiring, using ohmmeters, soldering irons, tape, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on wiring repair in physical environment

dwas.name: Repair electrical circuits or wiring.

tasks.text: Reset hardware, using chisels, mallets, and screwdrivers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reassembly after repair requires hands-on fitting

dwas.name: Reassemble equipment after repair.

tasks.text: Connect electrical systems to outside power sources and activate switches to test the operation of appliances and light fixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical power supply connection work

dwas.name: Control power supply connections.
Connect electrical components or equipment.

tasks.text: Refinish wood surfaces on cabinets, doors, moldings, and floors, using power sanders, putty, spray equipment, brushes, paints, or varnishes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Refinishing surfaces is skilled manual labor

dwas.name: Refinish wood or metal surfaces.
